verses.1: In the ninth year of Zedekiah, king of Judah, in the twelfth month, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and all his army came to Jerusalem. They set up siege against it.
verses.2: In the fifteenth year of Zedekiah’s reign, in the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the city was destroyed.
verses.3: And all the officers of King Babylon came and sat outside the gate of death. There were also Nergal, the officer in charge of the treasury; Samgar-Nevu, the officer in charge of the soldiers; Rab-Saris, another officer; Nergal, the officer in charge of the treasury again; and all the other officers of King Babylon.
verses.4: And when Rehoboam became king of Judah, and all the soldiers who were with him fled, they went out at night from the city, through the garden of the king’s palace, through a gate between the walls. They then went along the street.
verses.5: And the army of kidnappers pursued them. They captured Zadkiyah in the middle of the night. They took him and brought him to Nebukadnezar, king of Babylon. He was held captive in the land of Hamat. Then Nebukadnezar spoke with him about judgments.
verses.6: And King Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zadok in Ribla, right before his eyes. He also slaughtered all the leaders of the Jews.
verses.7: And the eyes of Zadkiah were blind, and they forbade him from bringing it into the furnace.
verses.8: And the king’s house and the people’s houses were burned down by the invaders. The treasures of Jerusalem were also destroyed.
verses.9: And all the people who remained in the city, and those who were fallen upon it. And all the people who remained there were taken captive by Nebuzar-Adan, the chief captain.
verses.10: And from the poor people who had no money, Nebuchadnezzar left many gifts in the land of Judah. He gave them grapes and other fruits on that day.
verses.11: And Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, commanded Jeremiah to be executed by Nebuzaradan, the chief officer.
verses.12: Take us and your eyes will focus on him. Do not do him any harm. For whatever he says to you, do it accordingly.
verses.13: And Nebuchadnezzar sent Rab-Tabachim, Nebuchshazban, Rab-Saris, Nergal, the treasurer, Rab-Mag, and all the rulers of Babylon.
verses.14: And they sent for Jérmeah from the palace of the king. They handed him over to Gadaliah, their son, so that he could lead him into the house. Then he sat among the people.
verses.15: And to Jeremiah, so was the word of Jehovah when he was still in the courtyard of the temple.
verses.16: And you said to the servant of the king of Kush, “As the Lord, the God of Israel, has said, ‘I will bring my words against this city, not for its good, but for its harm.’ May it be so in that day.”
verses.17: And you were saved on that day, as the LORD said. Do not let those people take control of you, for you are a chosen one by the LORD.
verses.18: For your sins have multiplied, and in your trouble you will not be saved. Your soul will become a source of sorrow for you, just as you relied on Me. Now, O LORD!
